verdict.rationale: Mixpanel is an analytics platform that markets monitoring agents, so asking whether automations can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back is a fair question. However, the evidence pack contains nothing on version history, review workflows or rollback for automations, agents, alerts or any other configured workflow. The API deprecation changelog is about API lifecycle, not user automations, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
